title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Revelation 8: the seventh seal, the golden censer and the first four trumpets.

questions.text: What happened in heaven when the seventh seal was opened?
questions.explanation: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

answers.text: There was silence for about half an hour
The temple was filled with smoke

questions.text: What was given to the seven angels who stand before God?
questions.explanation: The narrator saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

questions.text: What did the angel who stood over the altar add to the prayers of all the saints?
questions.explanation: Another angel came with a golden censer, and much incense was given to him to add to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar.

questions.text: What did the angel do with the censer after filling it with fire from the altar?
questions.explanation: The angel filled the censer with the fire of the altar and threw it on the earth, and thunders, sounds, lightnings and an earthquake followed.

answers.text: He set it before the throne
He threw it on the earth
He poured it into the sea
He gave it to another angel

questions.text: What followed when the first angel sounded his trumpet?
questions.explanation: There followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and one third of the earth and of the trees was burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

answers.text: A great star burning like a torch
Hail and fire, mixed with blood

questions.text: What was thrown into the sea when the second angel sounded?
questions.explanation: Something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea, and one third of the sea became blood.

answers.text: Something like a great burning mountain
A millstone of the great city

questions.text: What happened to one third of the ships?
questions.explanation: One third of the living creatures in the sea died, and one third of the ships were destroyed.

answers.text: They were driven to the land

questions.text: What is the name of the great star that fell when the third angel sounded?
questions.explanation: A great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and the name of the star is called “Wormwood”.

questions.text: What was struck when the fourth angel sounded?
questions.explanation: One third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened.

answers.text: One third of the sun, the moon and the stars
The throne of the beast and his kingdom
The rivers and the springs of water

questions.text: What did the eagle flying in mid heaven cry out?
questions.explanation: The narrator heard an eagle flying in mid heaven saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth,” because of the trumpets of the three angels who were yet to sound.

answers.text: “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God”
“Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth”
“Fear the Lord, and give him glory!”
